{{Quote|Lutwink was a well-regarded medic, until he started doing illegal image-redesign jobs for wanted criminals. '''Sporg Lutwink''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ScientistNPCTemplate.png|250px|thumb|All possible depictions of Sporg Lutwink]]
Sporg Lutwink was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Sporg Lutwink spawned under the generic "medic" template, his appearance was randomized under one of twelve possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Lutwink could appear as included [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] under either [[Gender/Legends|gender]], a male [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], and a female [[Zabrak]]. The [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Lutwink as male, however the [[canon]]ical species cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
